extra.final_summary: The data had two main issues affecting the analysis: (1) two rows with invalid flipper_length_mm values (-185 and -212 mm) were excluded as they were negative and below the minimum allowed value of 170 mm; (2) two rows with extreme body_mass_g values (4,450,000 g and 5,700,000 g) were excluded as they exceeded the maximum allowed value of 6,500 g. Additionally, the label 'FEMALE' in the 'sex' column was normalized to 'female' to match the allowed label set. After these fixes, the average body mass for each species was calculated: Adelie: 3,687.5 g, Chinstrap: 3,726.7 g, Gentoo: 5,253.6 g.
